item.title: I.O.I Gears Up for a 10th Anniversary Comeback
item.description: A decade after their explosive debut, I.O.I is officially returning to the spotlight. On February 23rd, Swing Entertainment confirmed that the group will make a comeback in May and is currently preparing a brand-new album. item.title: Apink Shines at 8th Solo Concert, Proving 15 Years of Unmatched Charm
item.description: Apink successfully wrapped up their eighth solo concert, The Origin: APINK, held on the 21st and 22nd at Jangchung Gymnasium—the first achievement of its kind among Korean girl groups. The concert celebrated their 15th anniversary with a sold-out audience and a setlist of 30 songs that spanned their entire musical journey.
